summary: Jackson Hole is the week's pivot point, with new Fed Chair Warsh delivering his first keynote today amid an audience still building its dictionary of what his signals mean. A hawkish lean from Collins this week already nudged Treasury yields higher and weighed on stocks and gold, while low volatility and crypto's sustained momentum suggest risk appetite remains resilient heading into his remarks.
tweet: Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote lands today with markets still learning his language — Collins already moved yields higher this week, keeping rate risk squarely in focus.
